name: DF Unified System
design: One door over five sealed containers. Members stay byte-for-byte where they are (sealed SHA256SUMS/MANIFEST are not rewritten); DF_Unified binds them by relative path, proves the shared adapter/core are one artifact, accounts for every unsealed overlay, and drives node and fabric batteries from a single CLI and console.
rule: No item is operational because its source file exists. Operational status requires native executable evidence satisfying that item's promotion gate.
locate: members are found beside DF_Unified (../DF_*), or under --root / DF_UNIFIED_ROOT

members.summary: Compact C11 reference VM; APDU/1 device path; Ed25519 signed images
Frozen 4.7.0 core, Device ABI 1.0 (8 classes), immutable release manifest
Device ABI 1.0 with 22 services; BRTM/1 trust design
Python-hosted QVM, RC-PW world services, per-step state hashing
Holds no VM: federation, fabric runtime, shared core, dialect bridge

overlays.note: VEC1 Photon control plane + shell, integrated 2026-09-22; added after the seal, so outside MANIFEST.json. Unbound by design: no attestation, build or workload promotion through it.
Post-Kubernetes Master Series batches 1-6 (6 owned + 89 dependency components); added after the seal.

topology.links: full mesh of 6 classical_channel links, local_process transport, alpha 1 tick, beta 1e6 B/tick (DF_Fabric/fabric/TOPOLOGY.json)

claim_boundary: NETWORK=deny, BACKEND=none; one host, local processes; distributed_state <= DISTRIBUTED_CLASSICAL_EMULATION
No node has a qubit; PHYSICAL_*_QPU_EXECUTION stay BLOCKED_EXTERNAL_AUTHORITY
Images are not portable between nodes; the fabric moves sealed rows and lowers per node
Every member blocker is inherited verbatim; DF_Unified lifts none
console: ui/ (DF VM Technical Institute v2.1.2 + Unified System page)
